teamwork.label: Teamwork and communication

form.commentsHint: Strengths, areas to work on, and the reasons for your recommendation.

Preboarding.title: Pre-boarding
Preboarding.startIntro: Read your offer letter and contract, accept them, then give the details your new employer needs before your first day.
Preboarding.noToken: This page needs the link from your offer email. Open the email and tap the button again.
Preboarding.oneDevice: The link works once. Open it on the phone or computer you will keep using; you can come back on that device until your start date.

linkErrors.link_invalid: This link isn't valid. Use the latest email from your new employer, or ask them to resend it.
linkErrors.link_used: This link was already opened on another device. Go back to that device, or ask HR to send you a new link.
linkErrors.link_expired: This link has expired. Ask HR to send you a new one.
linkErrors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Preboarding.noSessionTitle: Open the link from your email
Preboarding.noSessionBody: To see your offer, open the link in the email from your new employer on this device.
Preboarding.endedBody: If you have started work, sign in to Rakan with the invitation email. Otherwise ask HR to send you a new link.
Preboarding.noOffer: There is no open offer for you right now. Ask HR if you think this is wrong.
Preboarding.offerIntro: Read the offer letter and the contract that follows it, then accept by typing your full name. Please accept by {date}.
Preboarding.openFailed: Couldn't open the file. Try again.
Preboarding.personalIntro: As on your MyKad or passport. Your IC number is stored encrypted.
Preboarding.statutoryIntro: Leave a number blank if you don't have it yet. Your PCB category sets your monthly tax deduction.
Preboarding.bankIntro: Your salary is paid into this account. The number is stored encrypted.
Preboarding.credentialsIntro: Upload a clear photo or PDF of each certificate. HR checks them before you start.
Preboarding.credentialsNone: Your role has no required credentials. You can still upload certificates you hold.
Preboarding.finishReady: Everything required is in. Let HR know you're done; you can still make changes until your start date.
Preboarding.finishNotReady: Complete the steps above first. Dependents are optional.
Preboarding.finishDone: Sent to HR on {date}. You can still make changes until your start date.
Preboarding.privacy: {company} uses your details to employ and pay you, as set out in its privacy notice.

Leave.title: Leave
Leave.applied: Leave requested. Your manager has been asked to approve it.
Leave.notLinked: Your account isn't linked to an employee record yet. Ask HR.
Leave.adminIntro: Leave requests, the team calendar with public holidays and clashes, balances, the roster, attendance and overtime.

apply.noWorkingDays: These dates are rest days or holidays: no leave needed.
apply.attachmentHint: Take a photo or attach a PDF. Only you and HR can see it.
apply.override: Allow the balance to go below zero
apply.overrideHint: Only when agreed (e.g. advance leave). It shows as recorded beyond the balance.

problems.fileType: Choose a PDF, JPG or PNG.
problems.uploadFailed: The certificate didn't upload. Try again.

calendar.legendClash: Clash: two or more from one branch out
calendar.empty: No leave or holidays this month.

whosOut.title: Who's out
whosOut.none: Nobody is out in the next 7 days.

balances.title: Balances {year}
balances.legend: Days left / total this year (entitlement + carried over + adjustments). Unpaid leave shows days taken.
balances.recordIntro: For leave agreed outside Rakan (e.g. a paper MC). It's approved straight away.
balances.adjustIntro: Add or take away days, e.g. replacement leave earned for working on a public holiday. The reason is kept.
balances.daysHint: Use a minus sign to take days away, e.g. -1.

settings.intro: Leave types and how many days a year people get by length of service. Leave the law requires can be more generous here, never less than the Employment Act.
settings.unlimited: No yearly limit. Approved days go to payroll as unpaid leave.
settings.replacement: Earned by working on a public holiday or rest day: HR adds the days under Time off > Balances.
settings.noBands: No days set yet: people get 0 days of this leave until you add a band.

holidays.intro: Holidays for {state} and nationwide. When one falls on your rest day ({restDay}), the next working day is a paid holiday.
holidays.provisionalNote: Some dates are provisional until the official gazette (and Islamic holidays until the official announcement). Rakan will update them; check before planning around them.
holidays.title: Public holidays {year}
holidays.addIntro: A day off you give on top of the gazetted holidays. It counts as a holiday for leave.

Time.title: Time
Time.notLinked: Your account isn't linked to an employee record yet. Ask HR.
Time.noShifts: No published shifts this week or next.

today.outReason: Why are you clocking out outside the centre?
today.noFence: No location check for this branch.

roster.copied: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to copy.} one {# shift copied as a draft.} other {# shifts copied as drafts.}}
roster.published: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new to publish.} one {Published: # person told.} other {Published: # people told.}}
roster.legend: Dashed = draft (staff can't see it yet). Amber = a warning (leave, over 45 h, credential, rest day or holiday). Red = blocked by hard credential enforcement.

issues.WEEK_HOURS: {hours} hours that week: over the {cap}-hour normal week.
issues.CREDENTIAL_BLOCK: Blocked: {type} is {status} on that date (hard enforcement).
issues.HOLIDAY: Public holiday ({name}): work is paid as holiday OT.
issues.REST_DAY: Rest day: work is paid at rest-day rates.

attendance.title: Clock-ins
attendance.recordIntro: For a forgotten clock-in or someone without a phone. The reason is kept.

ot.title: Overtime
ot.hoursHint: Normal day: hours after your normal hours. Rest day or public holiday: all hours worked.

lines.rest_day_half: Rest day, up to half the normal hours: {multiplier} × {rate} (ORP) = {amount}
lines.rest_day_full: Rest day, more than half the normal hours: {multiplier} × {rate} (ORP) = {amount}
lines.holiday_normal: Public holiday, within the normal hours: {multiplier} × {rate} (ORP) = {amount}

notCovered.contract: Above the Employment Act wage threshold: overtime pay follows the contract (none set).
notCovered.none: This contract has no overtime pay.
notCovered.manual: Paid per session: HR enters the OT amount in payroll.

ot.overLimit: {hours} OT hours this month: over the {limit}-hour limit.
ot.recordIntro: For overtime agreed outside Rakan. It's approved straight away and goes to payroll.
ot.basis: ORP {orp} a day · HRP {hrp} an hour · {hours} normal hours

Claims.title: Claims
Claims.sent: Claim sent. Your manager will see it now.
Claims.notLinked: Your account is not linked to an employee record yet. Ask HR to link it.
Claims.noneForPayroll: No approved claims waiting for payroll.

form.noTypes: No claim types are open to you. Ask HR.
form.noRate: The company has not set a mileage rate yet, so mileage cannot be claimed. Ask HR.
form.overPerClaim: This is more than the {amount} allowed per claim.
form.overMonthly: This is more than your monthly limit. You have {amount} left this month.
form.descriptionHint: For example: Parking at Hospital Selayang for a home visit.
form.receiptsHint: A clear photo or PDF, up to 10 MB each.

problems.fileType: Only photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC) or PDF files.
problems.fileTooBig: Each file must be 10 MB or less.
problems.uploadFailed: The receipt did not upload. Check your connection and try again.

settings.intro: Claim types staff can choose, with their limits. Approved claims go to the next payroll, taxable or non-taxable by type. Ask your accountant which types are taxable.
settings.mileageNow: Mileage is paid at {rate} per km.
settings.mileageUnset: No mileage rate yet. Staff cannot claim mileage until it is set.
settings.mileageOwner: Only the Owner can change the mileage rate.
settings.taxable: Taxable (paid as part of taxable pay)
settings.whoHint: Tick none to let everyone claim.

BankAccounts.intro: The company accounts that pay salaries. Add any bank, choose the default for payroll, and retire old accounts. Retired accounts are kept for history and never deleted. Account numbers are always masked.
BankAccounts.none: No company bank account yet. Payroll needs one before the first payday.
BankAccounts.noDefault: No account is the default. Choose one so payroll knows which account pays.
BankAccounts.retireConfirm: Retire this account? It stays in the history but cannot be used for payroll again.
BankAccounts.retireDefaultConfirm: This is the default account. Retire it? Payroll will have no default until you choose another.
BankAccounts.formatHint: Generic CSV works with any bank's upload screen. Bank-specific formats appear here when they are added.
BankAccounts.accountNameHint: As the bank shows it, usually the company's registered name.
BankAccounts.bankIdHint: Only if your bank gave you one for bulk payments.
BankAccounts.numberFixed: The bank and account number cannot be changed later. For a new number, add a new account and retire this one.
BankAccounts.makeDefault: Use this account for payroll (make it the default)
BankAccounts.retiredIntro: Kept so past payroll runs still show which account paid them.

columns.title: File columns
columns.defaultIntro: This account uses the standard Generic CSV columns. Change them to match what your bank's upload screen asks for.
columns.ownIntro: This account has its own columns.
columns.transferHint: Leave both blank for SAME_BANK and INTERBANK.
